meta.review_notes: Policy contains a direct contradiction regarding facial recognition data. Location collection remains vague. The new scrape confirms the same behavioral profiling and AI scanning practices.

app.name: TeraBox: 1TB Cloud & AI Space
app.description: A cloud storage app offering up to 1TB of free space for files, photos, and videos, with AI-powered features for photo categorization and audio transcription.

verdict.one_liner: TeraBox states that it scans your uploaded photos with AI, sends audio to Google for transcription, and may build behavioral profiles for automated marketing.
verdict.summary: TeraBox is a cloud storage service that collects files you upload, your contacts, device information, and clipboard contents for specific features. It uses AI to categorize your uploaded photos, sends audio to Google for transcription, and explicitly states that it may create behavioral profiles for automated marketing. It offers encryption and account deletion features, but its broad data collection and sharing practices raise privacy concerns.
verdict.recommendation_reason: TeraBox offers free cloud storage, but the privacy cost is significant. Your files are scanned by AI, audio is sent to Google, and your behavior may be profiled for marketing. Consider alternatives with stronger privacy commitments.

red.title: Builds behavioral profiles for automated marketing
red.plain_english: TeraBox explicitly states that it may process your personal information to create profiles about your operation habits, interests, or credit. It says it uses these profiles for automated decision-making to send you personalized or marketing information.

red.title: Uses AI to categorize your uploaded photos
red.plain_english: TeraBox states that it provides smart classification services based on your uploaded data, including automated clustering of photos based on people, scenes, and geographic locations.

red.title: Sends your audio to Google for transcription
red.plain_english: TeraBox states that when you use its transcription or note-taking features, your audio content is transmitted to Google for processing.

red.title: May read your clipboard for specific features
red.plain_english: TeraBox states that it will read your clipboard information when you use invitation codes, access file links shared by other users, add friends through passwords, or obtain membership services through redemption codes.

red.title: Stores your contacts on its servers if you allow access
red.plain_english: TeraBox states that if you choose to allow it to access your contact information, it stores this information on its server for sharing and collaboration features.

green.title: Encrypts files at rest
green.plain_english: TeraBox states that it uses encryption of files at rest as part of its security measures.

green.title: Account deletion available in app
green.plain_english: TeraBox states that you can delete your account directly within the app settings at [Account Avatar] - [Menu] - [Settings] - [Security Center] - [Account Deletion].

green.title: Can opt out of marketing emails
green.plain_english: TeraBox states that you can opt out of receiving marketing material at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in emails.

green.title: Can withdraw permissions in device settings
green.plain_english: TeraBox states that you can directly disable access to contacts, photos, camera, and other permissions in your device system settings to change or withdraw authorization.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: TeraBox may access your camera when you choose to upload photos, and may send audio you upload to Google for transcription.
categories.detail: Camera access is used for uploading photos. Audio you upload for transcription is sent to Google for processing. The policy does not mention background camera or microphone access.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you enable camera permissions or authorize access to your photo library, please note that uploaded images may contain faces... When you use our transcription or note-taking features, the audio content you choose to upload is sent to our servers for processing. To provide transcription and note generation services, your audio content is transmitted to Google, our third-party AI service provider, for processing.
concerns: Audio sent to third-party Google servers
Policy does not clearly state whether camera access is optional or required

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that device information may include location information depending on your device settings, but does not clearly explain whether this means GPS or only IP-based location.
categories.detail: The policy mentions location information in the context of device information, stating it depends on device settings. It does not describe when or how GPS permission is requested, or whether location is used for purposes beyond optimization and protection.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information: This refers to information about the device used to access the Services and may include IP address, browser, and device information, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox, identifiers tied to the device, and location information depending on the device settings.
concerns: Ambiguous whether GPS or IP-based location is collected
Purpose beyond optimization is not clearly explained

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that if you allow it to access your contact information, it stores this information on its server for sharing and collaboration features.
categories.detail: Contact access is optional. If granted, TeraBox stores phone contacts, email addresses, and social media contacts on its servers.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can choose to allow TeraBox to access your contact information to facilitate certain operations... We store this information on our server for you to use.
concerns: Includes social media contacts if granted

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: As a cloud storage app, TeraBox stores the files, photos, and videos you upload. It also states that it may use AI to categorize your uploaded photos by people, scenes, and geographic locations.
categories.detail: All uploaded user data is stored on TeraBox servers. The policy states that smart classification services automatically cluster photos based on people, scenes, and geographic locations.
categories.policy_excerpt: User data: It is data that you store on TeraBox, such as files, documents, photos, videos, and audio... we provide smart classification services based on User Data (including automated clustering of photos based on people, scenes, and geographic locations).
concerns: AI analysis of uploaded photo content

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that it shares your audio content with Google for transcription, may share infrastructure with Flextech affiliates, and may work with trusted third-party service providers. When you use Teamwork or Share functions, your information is visible to other users you cooperate with.
categories.detail: Data is shared with Google for audio transcription, with Flextech affiliates for infrastructure, and with third-party service providers. Cross-border transfers are mentioned. User-initiated sharing features expose data to other users.
categories.policy_excerpt: To provide transcription and note generation services, your audio content is transmitted to Google, our third-party AI service provider, for processing. We may share infrastructure, systems, and technology with Flextech affiliates... We may work with certain trusted third parties (such as customer support or IT service providers).

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: TeraBox collects your email, phone number, and social media profile data for your account. For some services, it states that you must provide your real name, identity document number, and facial recognition information.
categories.detail: Account creation requires email or phone. Social login imports nickname and profile image. Some services require real-name verification including identity document number and facial recognition. Real-name data may be compared with government records.
categories.policy_excerpt: Account information: We collect information such as the email address and phone number that you provide to us when you perform operations such as registering for an account... if you log in with an SNS account, then we will receive your nickname and SNS profile image... you must provide your real name, identity document number, and facial recognition information for account authentication... we may compare the real-name information you provide to Terabox with that registered at institutions permitted by laws and regulations or authorized by government agencies.
concerns: Facial recognition required for some features
Social login links external profile data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: TeraBox explicitly states that it may process your personal information to create profiles about your operation habits, interests, or credit, and uses these profiles for automated decision-making to send you personalized or marketing information.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly describes creating 'label information' from personal information to reflect operation habits, interests, or credit. This is used for automated decision-making and marketing. Users can refuse via contact or app settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: to form a variety of label information with different degrees of granularity that reflect your operation habits, interests, or credit... We will use label information for automated decision-making in specific scenarios and applications, so as to send you personalized information and/or marketing information.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that users must be at least 13 years old, but does not describe how it verifies age.
categories.detail: The policy states that no one under 13 is allowed and users must be at least 13. There is no description of age verification mechanisms.
categories.policy_excerpt: No one under 13 is allowed to use or access the Services... you are at least 13 years old and over the minimum age for accessing and using the Services as required by the laws of your country

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that it collects your IP address and the web pages you visited before opening TeraBox. It says this is used to optimize and protect the Services, but does not clearly explain all purposes.
categories.detail: Device information includes IP address and referrer pages. Usage information includes editing, viewing, creating, and moving files. Stated purpose is optimization and protection.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information: This refers to information about the device used to access the Services and may include IP address, browser, and device information, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox, identifiers tied to the device... Usage information: It is information about how the Services are used, including operations performed in your account such as editing, viewing, creating, and moving files or folders.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that it collects device information that may include identifiers tied to your device. It says this is used to optimize and protect the Services, but does not clearly explain whether these identifiers are used for advertising or tracking.
categories.detail: The policy mentions 'identifiers tied to the device' as part of device information. The stated purpose is optimization and protection. The behavioral profiling section does not explicitly link device identifiers to marketing.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information: This refers to information about the device used to access the Services and may include IP address, browser, and device information, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox, identifiers tied to the device, and location information depending on the device settings.
concerns: Purpose for ads or tracking not explicitly stated

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that you must provide facial recognition information for account authentication on some services. It also claims not to collect or store facial biometric information, which contradicts the requirement for facial recognition data.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly requires facial recognition information for some services, but immediately claims not to collect or store facial biometric information. This is contradictory. Smart Photo Categorization also identifies people in photos.
categories.policy_excerpt: you must provide your real name, identity document number, and facial recognition information for account authentication... We do not collect or store any users' facial biometric information.
concerns: Facial recognition required for some features
Portrait identification in photos via AI categorization

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that in-app purchases are processed through your Software Store account, so it does not directly collect your credit card information.
categories.detail: Payment processing for in-app purchases goes through Apple/Google Software Store. Website payment method is unspecified.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you make an in-app purchase, you will be prompted to enter details for your account with your Software Store.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that you may delete your account through the app or by email, but deletion may take 30 days and some information may be retained for legal obligations, dispute resolution, or backup storage.
categories.detail: Account deletion available via app settings or email. 30-day processing time. May be delayed for identity verification, backup deletion, or legal retention.
categories.policy_excerpt: we will delete your account within 30 days after receiving your request. However, 1) we will not delete your account information until we have verified your user identity; 2) such deletion of information from our servers and backup storage may be delayed; 3) we may retain this information if necessary to fulfill our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or exercise our rights under the Contract.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: TeraBox states that it will post privacy policy revisions on its website and will notify you if a revision materially affects your rights. It does not clearly explain how you will be notified or what happens if you do not agree to the changes.
categories.detail: Policy changes posted on website. Notification only if materially affects rights. No explicit description of notification method.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will release the latest version of it on TeraBox's website if a revision is made. We will notify you if any such revision materially affects your rights.
concerns: Material effect threshold for notification is subjective
